fact: Burundi's Council of Ministers of 8 May 2024 analysed and adopted the memorandum of understanding on the DRC-Burundi fibre-optic interconnection project, described as a joint initiative, per the government communique reported by ABP.

ITWeb Africa reports that Burundi and Zambia signed an MoU at the Digital Government Africa Summit in Lusaka for a fibre cable under Lake Tanganyika linking Zambia's Northern province to Burundi's Makamba province, with a private firm, not yet named, contracted.
